title: [Good First Issue]: Enable parallel execution of MO Python API python tests
body:
### Context

Current CI (https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/c0381ab08d2fcdc51c621196e935aa02c64a4b50/.github/workflows/linux.yml#L869) runs all the python tests sequentially one by one and it takes too much time.
The idea is to run all those tests in parallel by using pytest-xdist plugin, but tests should be modified for that.
Please find bellow the common tests issues:
- Random inputs generation as parametrization arguments. Solution: all random test arguments should be generated inside of the tests 
- Tests create, use and remove the same artifacts (temporary data, models, etc). Hot fix solution: all test data should be generated in the system temporary directory (TMPDIR) which can be unique for each thread. Long term solution: all test data should be generated in the unique temporary directory or with unique names.

### What needs to be done?

- Modify MO Python API tests to solve issues described in the Context. Tests are located here - https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/tree/master/tests/layer_tests/mo_python_api_tests
- Enable parallel execution of those test in the CI (https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/4a0098b26ad6c4cbae97fbe34505fa63c08036eb/.github/workflows/linux.yml#L991C15-L991C34)

### Example Pull Requests

https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/pull/20613

- [Contribution guide - start here!](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)

- Setting the cores to auto using the -n auto flag in the existing github actions commands ( with pytest-xdist plugin as a prerequisite ). This would enable parallelization. 
- Generating random inputs, the linked PR has good examples, I will most probably use the same code. 
- Using tempfile.mkdtemp() to create a unique directory for temp files. 

Thank you for your time! :)
